why_this_fixture: Hand-built to cover every field the parser handles, including shapes no shipping Apple app exercises: every primitive type identifier, arrays of entities and of strings, a measurement/duration, an IntentFile, an enum with a case that has no display title, unknown type identifiers and an unknown wrapper kind (both must degrade to UNKNOWN, not raise), a parameter with no valueType at all, a deprecated intent, a hidden intent, a schema-conformant intent, an intent with a title but no description, an intent with neither, an identifier that is not a legal tool name, and one structurally malformed node that must produce a ParseWarning without aborting the parse.
